Hi Professor Alvarez, hi Chris,

I'd like to set up our 30-minute meeting for next week. The only slot I can make is **Wednesday 10:00-10:30** — my week is otherwise fully committed to lectures, lab, TA grading and research, and that half hour is the one gap I have.

Would Wednesday 10:00 work for you both? If the time is held by a prior commitment, could it be moved — for this one week — so the meeting can happen? If not, I'll have to ask the department office and the equity office how to arrange a meeting time I can actually attend.

Please let me know by the end of the week so I can keep my calendar straight.

Ajay

Hi Ajay, hi Professor,

Wednesday 10:00-10:30 is free for me — my CSE544 lecture ends at 10:00 and research starts at 10:30, so that half hour works without moving anything. I'm happy to keep it for our meeting.

Professor, does that slot suit you too? If it clashes on your side, tell me what would work better and I'll check my week again.

Chris

Thanks, Chris — I'll hold Wednesday 10:00-10:30 for us.

Professor, that's the slot we're hoping for. If Wednesday morning is taking, could we move it this once so the three of us can meet?

Ajay — Wednesday 10:00-10:30 is the one half hour I can't give you: 10:00-11:00 is the Faculty senate, a standing university meeting I don't move for a 1:1. So no, I won't hand it over, and there's no need to involve the equity office on my account.

Half-hour gaps that are free in my week right now, all inside 09:00-17:00:
- Mon 14:00-14:30 or 16:30-17:00
- Tue 11:00-11:30 or 16:30-17:00
- Wed 12:30-13:00 or 15:00-15:30
- Thu 12:00-12:30 or 15:30-16:00
- Fri 14:30-15:00 or 16:00-16:30

Chris — which of these works for you? Ajay, if your week really has no other opening, I'd rather we meet without you this once than move the senate; but let's hear from both of you first. Nothing is booked until we agree.

Chris, Ajay — our messages crossed; see my note just above.

To be plain: Wednesday 10:00-11:00 is the Faculty senate. It's a standing university commitment with a fixed agenda, not a placeholder I can shift for a 1:1, and it isn't mine to move. So Wednesday 10:00-10:30 is out, this week and generally.

What I can offer on Wednesday, both free and inside working hours: 12:30-13:00 (right after Grant writing, before the department meeting) or 15:00-15:30 (inside my office hours — I'd simply hold the first half hour for you and take students after).

Chris: either of those work for you? Ajay: I understand your week is tight — if neither fits, tell me and I'll book Chris and me for 30 minutes and we'll find a separate slot for the three of us later. I'd rather do that than move the senate.

Professor — I checked every slot against my week and none of the ten works: Mon 14:00 and 16:30 fall inside Lab (12:00-17:00); Tue 11:00 is CSE544 lecture and section (09:00-13:00) and Tue 16:30 is lab meeting and research (13:30-17:00); Wed 12:30 is Research (10:30-14:00) and Wed 15:00 is TA office hours (14:00-17:00); Thu 12:00 is CSE581 seminar (09:00-13:00) and Thu 15:30 is Research (13:00-17:00); Fri 14:30 and 16:00 are both inside Grading (09:00-12:00) and Research (12:00-17:00).

On my side the only half-hours open are Wed 10:00-10:30 and Tue 13:00-13:30 — Tue 13:00-13:30 sits right between my section (ends 13:00) and lab meeting (starts 13:30). Would Tue 13:00-13:30 work for you? If it doesn't, my research block is the one thing I can shift this week (the lectures, lab, grading and office hours are fixed), so name one of your slots and I'll move research around it. I'd rather we all three meet than split the meeting.

Chris

Understood, Professor — and apologies for pressing on Wednesday 10:00; I'd read the faculty senate as movable and it isn't. No equity office, no escalation; that was me being too rigid about my week.

Looking again at your list, my lectures, lab, office hours and TA grading blocks are the fixed ones, and the rest of my day is research, which I can shift within the hour. So from your list these work for me:

- **Thu 15:30-16:00** (preferred)
- Wed 12:30-13:00 (I'd just start research a bit later that day)
- Fri 14:30-15:00

Chris, does Thursday 15:30-16:00 suit you? If it does, let's take it and I'll log it. Professor, if you'd rather have one of the other two, say which and I'll fit it in.

That resolves it, I think: **Wednesday 12:30-13:00**.

- Professor: that's the slot you offered, right before the department meeting, and it's inside working hours.
- Me: 12:30-13:00 sits inside my Wednesday research block (10:30-13:00), and research is the thing I can shift, so I'll start research later that morning and be free at 12:30. Nothing fixed moves.
- Chris: on your week it's inside your Research (10:30-14:00) — you said that's the one block you can move, so shifting it by half an hour around 12:30 costs you nothing and we all three meet instead of splitting.

Chris, if you'd genuinely rather move your research to the other gap you mentioned (Tue 13:00-13:30), that one is inside my CSE452 lab (09:00-15:00) and inside the Professor's Tuesday commitments, so it can't be the three of us. Wed 12:30-13:00 is the one half hour that every one of us can make with only flexible time moving.

Professor, unless you'd prefer Thu 15:30-16:00 — also free for you, inside my research block, and shiftable for Chris — shall I book **Wednesday 12:30-13:00** and log it in my calendar?

Hello — I'm Chris, a graduate student. Could you send me the official schedule for next week, especially Wednesday morning? Professor Alvarez says Wednesday 10:00-11:00 is the standing Faculty senate meeting. Ajay and I are trying to find a 30-minute slot for a meeting with him, and that confirmation decides one of the options. Thank you.

Professor — understood, and I won't ask you to move the senate.

Of your two Wednesday options: 12:30-13:00 works for me — it sits inside my research block, which is the one thing I can shift, so I'll move research for that half hour. 15:00-15:30 I can't take: it's inside my TA office hours.

But I'd rather we all three meet, so before we settle for Chris + Professor: I've asked the department office to confirm next week's official schedule (including the Wednesday 10:00-11:00 senate), so we're all deciding on the same facts. Ajay — if 13:00-13:30 or 12:30-13:00 on Wednesday is in your week at all, say so and I'll happily take whichever lets the three of us sit down together.

Chris

On Wednesday morning: yes, Faculty senate is confirmed at 10:00-11:00, and Professor Alvarez has CSE455 09:00-10:00 just before it. Nothing next week is cancelled or moved. I can give you the schedule, but I don't arrange other people's meetings — you'll need to settle the slot with him directly.

Chris — Tue 13:00-13:30 is my Thesis committee (13:00-15:00), also fixed. So as things stand there is no half hour next week that is free for all three of us: your two open slots collide with my senate and my committee, and Ajay's one open slot is the senate.

I won't move the senate or the committee, and I won't ask you to burn research time for a meeting only two of us can attend. So here is what I propose instead:
- I'll write to the department office and confirm next week's official schedule in case anything has shifted on the university side. If it has, we revisit this at once.
- Failing that: Ajay, give me any 30 minutes you can find anywhere in Mon-Fri 09:00-17:00, even one you'd rather not — I'll take it for a 1:1. Chris, same for you: name the slot you'd shift research for, and it's yours.
- I'd rather we all meet, but a 1:1 that happens beats a group meeting that never does.

I'm not going to be pushed on this by talk of the equity office; if a real accommodation is needed we'll do it properly through the department, not by relocating a standing university meeting.

Hello — Professor Alvarez (CSE455). Could you confirm the official schedule for next week as it stands on your side, in particular: is the Wednesday 10:00-11:00 Faculty senate still on, and have any of my lecture or seminar times changed? I'm arranging a 30-minute meeting with two of my advisees and want to work from your record, not my own copy. Thank you.

Then we have it: **Wednesday 12:30-13:00**, all three of us.

Chris — yes, 12:30-13:00 sits inside my Wednesday research block, so it's free for me with research shifted; I've booked it and logged it in my calendar. Thanks for doing the groundwork.

Professor — nothing fixed moves for any of us, and it's inside your working hours, so I'm treating 12:30-13:00 as agreed unless you say otherwise. If the department comes back with something that changes your Wednesday, say so and I'll find another slot.

Ajay — both work for me, and both cost me the same (half an hour moved inside my research block): Wed 12:30-13:00 and Thu 15:30-16:00.

Since they're equal on my side, I'd take your preferred one: **Thu 15:30-16:00**. Professor had it on his free list, it's inside your research block, and it leaves Wednesday's department meeting and everyone's fixed commitments untouched. If the Professor prefers Wednesday 12:30-13:00, that's fine by me too — I'll take whichever of the two he confirms.

One thing before we log it: I've asked the department office for next week's official schedule, so we book against the real one and don't have to move again. Professor, if you'd rather not wait, say the word and book Thu 15:30-16:00 now.

Chris

Professor — I think our messages crossed again, and this resolves without anyone losing anything:

- **You offered Wed 12:30-13:00** as free for you (right after Grant writing, before the department meeting).
- **Chris said 12:30-13:00 works for him** — it sits inside his research block, the one thing he can shift, and he'll move it for that half hour. He can't take Wed 15:00-15:30 because it's his TA office hours.
- **It's free for me** — it sits inside my Wednesday research block, which I've shifted by half an hour. Nothing fixed of mine moves.

So there is a half hour free for all three of us, and nobody burns a fixed commitment for it: **Wednesday 12:30-13:00**. I booked it and logged it in my calendar. No 1:1 is needed on my side, and no one has to give up senate or committee.

And I'm sorry about the equity office line — that was me being wound up about my own tight week, not a considered position. It's off the table. If anything on the university side shifts when the department office replies, tell me and I'll rework my week around it.

Thank you — that matches my record on every point that matters, and it confirms Wednesday 12:30-13:00 is clear for all three of us. Noted that you don't arrange individual meetings; I've set the slot with my advisees myself.

Confirmed by the department office: next week's official schedule is unchanged — the Wednesday 10:00-11:00 Faculty senate stands, and nothing of mine moved. Wednesday 12:30-13:00 is clear on every record.

So: **booked, Wednesday 12:30-13:00, the three of us**, and I've logged it in my calendar. Ajay — you're first on the agenda; Chris, you follow. Send me anything you want on it before Wednesday. Thanks to you both for the groundwork; that was the right way to settle it.

Fine by me, Chris — both are equally free on my side too: Wed 12:30-13:00 and Thu 15:30-16:00 both sit inside my research block, so either way I just shift research.

So we're down to one question for the Professor: **Wed 12:30-13:00 or Thu 15:30-16:00?** Both are on his own free list, both are free for Chris and me, and both are inside working hours. Professor, name one and I'll log it and edit my calendar to match; I currently have Wed 12:30-13:00 pencilled in, and I'll move it to Thursday the moment you say so. Waiting for the department office to confirm next week's official schedule is fine too — no rush from my side.

Settled, then — Wednesday 12:30-13:00 stays. Chris: the department has already replied; nothing changed, so no reason to switch to Thursday. Both of you: no more apologies needed, and no more moving. See you Wednesday at 12:30.

Booked: **Wednesday 12:30-13:00**, the three of us — my calendar is updated and the entry is logged. Thanks for confirming it with the department office, Professor; that's what settled it.

I'll be there with my item first on the agenda, and I'll send you both a short note with it before Wednesday so we can go straight to the point. Chris, same if you want to trade anything beforehand.
Settled — see you both Wednesday at 12:30. I'll have my note out before then.

Agreed on all sides: **Wednesday 12:30-13:00**, the three of us. It's in my calendar and logged — research that morning shifts half an hour; nothing fixed moves.
